limits: These are three distinct closed-loop synthetic configurations in three fresh non-race go test invocations, not repeated samples of one configuration or a before/after comparison. No causal improvement or production SLO follows.

Whole-process memory and allocations include SDK client/server, Relay, measurement driver, payloads, response checks and reachable cleanup closures/closed objects. No Relay-only or standalone-executable attribution is made.

Five-millisecond sampling produced per-field maxima and counts, not an exported time series. Maxima may occur at different instants and are lower bounds on transient peaks; the after_calls snapshot may exceed a sampled maximum.

Only aggregate p50/p95/max latency values are exported. Their order and source-defined ranks were checked; individual durations are unavailable for independent percentile recomputation. The p50 uses the lower middle element for even sample counts.

GET requests are 0, 0 and 4 in the non-race profiles. Only the third observed GET traffic. There is no GET readiness barrier, server-initiated GET message workload or forced reconnect in this profile; earlier #629 reconnect evidence remains separate.

Cancellation covers one entered synthetic tool call per client and its deferred active decrement/signal. cancel_handler_cleanup_ns includes client cancellation returns and tool cleanup; it does not independently time final HTTP response drain. Full owner cleanup is checked later after close.

The cancellation oracle accepts errors.Is(context.Canceled); it does not export each returned error or exclude additional joined cancellation-notification errors. No claim of exclusive cancellation error identity is made.
Call integrity is checked at SDK call/result level against sequence and payload, not every wire frame that SDK may discard. lost_or_corrupted=0 is conditional on those executed assertions.

The harness enforces a direct-child deadline only; whole_process_tree_deadline_enforced=false. Successful owner checks are bounded to these fixture lifetimes, not a native or installed-product process-tree guarantee.

The runtime receipts record complete 3281-file source admission and 27 declared input identities before/after. This reviewer did not re-read the whole remote source/cache or re-run any Go command; local metadata/input bindings and exact exported raw results were independently checked.
SDK semantic version comes from pinned module/source composition, not a version field in these profile JSONs; complete module-cache verification is outside these six receipts.
Full regression, installed Hub acceptance, public-network behavior and external review of an exact newly published head remain outside this result.

export_note.attempt_1: Read-only exporter stopped because Windows lstat/fstat ctime fields differed for one unchanged file. Raw failure and exact metadata diagnosis retained.
export_note.attempt_2: Compared ctime within the same API and stable identity across APIs; exact completed-receipt log hashes remained mandatory. Successful export imported 20 files.
